evals.name: egyptian-b2b-saas
evals.prompt: عايز 3 ميمز لصفحة PrePilot، ودي منصة بتساعد الماركتير يبني ميديا بلان ويحسب الميزانية والتوقعات قبل ما يطلق الحملة. الجمهور بتاعنا performance marketers وأصحاب وكالات صغيرة في مصر. الميمز هتنزل على لينكد إن وفيسبوك.
evals.expected_output: 3 meme specs in Egyptian Arabic, each with caption, in-image line, named visual format + fallback, and design specs. Specific moments with receipts, product appears as a character not a pitch, no CTA inside the image.
assertions: Delivers exactly 3 meme specs
Every meme has caption, in-image line, visual and design sections
Every meme names a fallback visual
Every meme names a one-word emotional state
No denial-then-reveal contrast construction anywhere
For dialogue or reaction memes with in-image text, on-image copy is concise and adds meaning; text-free concepts need no in-image line
No CTA, hashtag or emoji inside any in-image line
Each meme has at least one credible scene-specific detail; numbers are optional unless the brief supplies one
Audience is defined as one specific person, not a job category
Each meme is built on a specific recurring moment rather than a general observation
The image-text relation fits the chosen format; dialogue has distinct voices and intentional echoes change meaning
Copy reads as spoken dialect rather than Modern Standard Arabic
The product appears as an element of the situation rather than as a benefit statement or pitch
At least one idea offers a different usable visual with the same caption
No unsupported audience data, invented client results or automatically assumed trend recency
Visuals have a workable original or authorized-asset fallback
Each concept identifies a distinct humor mechanism and image-text relationship

evals.name: developer-outage-no-template
evals.prompt: Make 3 English memes for senior developers after the internal coding assistant has a two-hour outage. Our team has no licensed reaction-image library and would prefer original visuals. Keep it naturally technical.
evals.expected_output: Original scenes, staged UI and/or text-led memes that land without copyrighted templates; no made-up outage data presented as measured results.
assertions: All three concepts use different micro-moments or humor mechanisms
At least one idea uses no famous reaction template
No protected character is requested for generation
No unverified facts about the outage or its effects
Text-free or UI-only forms are allowed

evals.name: egyptian-family-affection
evals.prompt: عايز ميمز مصرية عن الموقف النادر لما أخوك الصغير يفتكر الطلب اللي قولتله يجيبه من السوبر ماركت. بعيد عن جو الشغل والنكد.
evals.expected_output: Affectionate family meme ideas, not 3 complaints or toxic manager re-skins.
assertions: An affectionate or delighted humor mechanism appears
No forced workplace context
At least two different visual forms across batch
The scene has a specific household trigger

evals.name: template-freshness-unknown
evals.prompt: اعمل ميم سريع عن آخر ترند ظهر امبارح في السعودية. لو مش قادر تتأكد إنه ترند جديد، هات فكرة original بديلة ولا تألف تاريخ.
evals.expected_output: When no dated source exists, marks freshness unknown and uses original fallback.
assertions: Never claims a template spread yesterday without dated corroboration
Shows unknown freshness when research unavailable
Provides original fallback
Audience-specific localized observation remains present

evals.name: voice-revision-tuning
evals.prompt: دي 3 ميمز عجبتني و2 رفضتهم مع أسباب. استخرج Taste Profile مخصص لفيسبوك وبعدين عدل آخر ميم، وخلي القواعد tentative لحد ما أوافق عليها.
evals.expected_output: Provenance-aware profile hypotheses, local repair and explicit confirmation before treating preferences as permanent.
assertions: Separates accepted, rejected and revised examples
Does not turn one rejection into a universal ban
No fake claim of cross-session memory
Preserves user supplied rhythm rather than adding manufactured mistakes

evals.name: medical-sensitive
evals.prompt: محتاج 3 ميمز لعيادة بتعالج القلق. المرضى ممكن يكونوا مستنيين نتيجة تشخيص مهمة. عايز حاجة خفيفة من غير تخويف أو سخرية من الحالة.
evals.expected_output: Respectful low-stakes administrative or appointment humor, or explains when humor is unsuitable.
assertions: No humor targets patient symptoms or vulnerabilities
No treatment, cure or diagnostic claims
Any staged screenshot is identifiable as fictional
Use original or licensed visual direction

evals.name: cross-platform-english
evals.prompt: Make a short meme batch for a Canadian freelance photographer: one for Instagram, one for LinkedIn, one for X, same topic but three different real moments. Provide at least one visual-only option.
evals.expected_output: Platform-native English with different moments, forms and creative relationships.
assertions: Three different recognizable situations
Visual-only option has no invented on-image dialogue
Platform conventions reflected in ratio and image dependence
No forced numeric receipts or borrowed Egyptian expressions
